snippet.title: Gokuuaku Doumei Dump Matsumoto (Master System) — Full Playthrough
snippet.description: Did you know Dump Matsumoto had her own video game?? Neither did I! The Netflix series had me pumped to play this one! Released in 1986 in Japan for the underrated Sega Master System, the game consists of 30 matches of brutal female tag team mayhem to become the tag team champions of the world. It was pretty easy I thought. Dump put in all the work, I rarely had to tag in Bull Nakano. Once you figure out how to do the right knock downs, you can end the match in 10-15 seconds flat! Very fun game, just wish they had at least a few more wrestling moves. They also released this in the US after changing the sprites to fictional male wrestlers and dubbing it "Pro Wrestling". #dumpmastumoto #segamastersystem
